Definition: alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin
BiblicalUsage: bedil — alloy, tin, dross — it shows up 6 times, including Numbers 31:22.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bedil shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
